display.purpose: Heavy uppercase page and artist titles.

body.purpose: Compact, readable operational copy and metadata.

shadows.name: floating-control
shadows.purpose: Reserved for actions, menus and dialogs that float above the archive.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and disclosure feedback; reduced to near-zero when requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The canonical action used for saving and adding.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 24px; border:1px solid #2563eb; border-radius:8px; background:#2563eb; color:#fff; font:900 12px/1 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#3b82f6; border-color:#3b82f6; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e4e4e7; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact dark field used across search, forms and filters.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height:44px; width:260px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #30343a; border-radius:8px; background:#111418; color:#f4f4f5; font:600 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#52525b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e4e4e7; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Archive Panel
components.description: The raised structural surface for statistics and grouped concert data.
components.css: .ds-panel { width:280px; padding:16px; border:1px solid #30343a; border-radius:6px; background:#15191e; color:#f4f4f5; font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-panel strong { font-size:14px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.025em; } .ds-panel p { margin:8px 0 0; color:#a1a1aa; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; }

narrative.overview: Bold uppercase hierarchy gives the archive authority while restrained dark operating surfaces keep years of personal concert data usable.

rules.name: Data Provides the Texture
rules.body: Use chronology, artists, venues and setlists as the primary texture; the home dashboard may use anonymous darkened concert-stage photography as its approved atmospheric exception.

rules.name: Application Shell
rules.body: Authenticated desktop views use a fixed compact sidebar, blue primary actions, compact left-aligned headers and dense viewport-filling layouts; mobile returns to the menu drawer and a single-column stack.

rules.name: Theme Pair
rules.body: Default uses compact corners and blue primary actions. Concert Poster uses deeper blacks, zinc surfaces, generous rounded panels, concert-white primary actions, centered content and an on-demand drawer without changing behavior or semantic concert colors. Poster stays 1280px wide at 1920px, then preserves a two-thirds viewport proportion on larger displays. The account preference is synchronized through Supabase and cached locally for flash-free startup.

dos: Reserve heavy uppercase typography for hierarchy
donts: Use hidden gestures as the only action path
